D

The magnetic force per unit length between two long parallel wires is proportional to the product of their currents (F/L ∝ I₁I₂). By Newton's third law, the forces on the two wires are equal in magnitude. When the current in wire Y () is increased while the current in wire X () is constant, the product * increases. Consequently, the magnitude of the force on both wire X and wire Y increases.
